New access tokens and token exchanges stop

and never past its own 5-minute life.
How this differs from the web login (auth flows diagram)

The browser gets HttpOnly cookies and Kong verifies the JWT on every call. An MCP host holds a bearer token for a different audience (/mcp), identifies itself by client metadata URL or registration, shows the user a consent screen with scopes, and never sends its token to the API: mcp-service exchanges it per call for a
one-scope /api token. Access tokens last 15 minutes; refresh tokens rotate and expire after 24 hours without use.
